title: 第17章 暴打林宏炎第18章 古心德
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
虞映雪注视着下方意气风发的林宏炎。
容貌并不出众，只能说是顶多有点清秀。
但这掩盖不了他那傲世于天的气质，让人感觉充满了魅力。
她心跳加速，久久沉默。
最终咬唇下定了决心。
“我…我愿意！”
她不再想沦为家族联姻的牺牲品。
而且林宏炎现在有天道院与紫霄丹宗在背后撑腰，根本不怕姜家。
她父亲，也会为此感到高兴的！
殿中众人神色剧变。
姜家之人更是一个个面色铁青，仿佛被狠狠扇了一个响亮的耳光。
这是在当众打他们的脸啊！
姜成益怒火中烧，指着虞映雪，声音低沉却带着无法掩饰的愤怒：
“虞映雪，你这是何意？我姜家此前有亏待过你吗？你竟然如此羞辱于我！
？”
虞映雪刚欲启唇解释。
林宏炎便当即跳出来，冷笑道：
“羞辱你又怎样？映雪根本瞧不上你，你还强行逼迫她成婚？又算得上什么好人？要我说……”
轰轰！
忽然。

天际之上，一道惊天雷霆划破长空，轰鸣声震撼天地。
紧随其后，一阵震撼心魄的龙吟悠扬响起。
吼！
吼吼！
所有人惊愕抬头。
九条如白玉般晶莹的苍龙自天际奔腾而出，拖拉着一辆金光闪闪的车辇。
车体如一座悬空浮动的宫殿，车身发出的光辉照耀四方，栩栩如生，象征着无上的奢华与尊贵。
车辇尚未落地，一道令人心悸的身影自虚空浮现。
正是姜一。
“姜族神子亲临！”
“尔等还不速速迎接！”
姜族天卫！
准帝！
content_en:
Yu Yingxue stared at the high-spirited Lin Hongyan below.
His appearance is not outstanding, it can only be said that he is a little delicate at best.
But this cannot conceal his arrogant temperament, which makes people feel full of charm.
Her heartbeat quickened and she was silent for a long time.
Finally, he bit his lip and made up his mind.
"I...I do!"
She no longer wanted to become a victim of family marriage.
Moreover, Lin Hongyan now has the support of Tiandaoyuan and Zixiao Danzong, so he is not afraid of the Jiang family at all.
Her father will also be happy about this!
The expressions of everyone in the palace changed drastically.
Everyone in the Jiang family looked livid, as if they had been slapped loudly.
This is a slap in their face in public!
Jiang Chengyi was furious, pointing at Yu Yingxue, his voice was low but with unconcealable anger:
"Yu Yingxue, what do you mean by this? Have my Jiang family ever treated you badly before? You actually humiliated me like this!
? "
Yu Yingxue was about to open her lips to explain.
Lin Hongyan jumped out immediately and sneered:
"So what if I humiliate you? Yingxue doesn't look down on you at all, and you force her to get married? Who are you a good person? Let me tell you..."
Boom boom!
suddenly.
Above the sky, a shocking thunder pierced the sky, and the roar shook the world.
Immediately afterwards, a heart-shaking dragon roar sounded.
roar!
Hoho!
Everyone looked up in shock.
Nine blue dragons, as crystal clear as white jade, galloped out from the sky, pulling a gleaming golden chariot.
The car body is like a suspended palace, and the light from the car body shines in all directions, lifelike, symbolizing supreme luxury and nobility.
Before the chariot landed, a heart-stopping figure emerged from the void.
It was Jiang Yi.
"The Son of God of the Jiang Clan is here in person!"
"Why don't you welcome me quickly!"
Jiang Clan Heavenly Guard!
Quasi-Emperor!
